profiles.headline: I look beyond the problem to understand the system creating it.
paragraphs: I am a Business Analyst and technology practitioner interested in how organisations operate, how people interact with systems, and how technology can improve the way work gets done.

My work sits at the intersection of business strategy, process improvement and emerging technology. I translate complex organisational needs into structured requirements, better workflows and practical digital solutions.
I think about the entire system: the people, processes, information, technology and decisions that make it work.
focusAreas: Data sovereignty and locally deployed AI

profiles.headline: I bring people closer to the ideas shaping our technological future.
paragraphs: I am a technology advocate, speaker and community builder working to make emerging technologies more accessible, practical and inclusive.

Since 2020, I have been involved in developer communities, technology education and events across Africa and beyond. Through talks, workshops and community initiatives, I explore how people can move beyond consuming technology to understanding, questioning and building with it.
My speaking is centred on three things: people, technology and impact.
